FROM cards
WHERE name IN ('Serra Angel', 'Shrine Keeper')
GROUP BY name
ORDER BY MAX(convertedManaCost) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name, l.status
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.types = 'Artifact'
  AND c.side IS NULL
  AND l.format = 'vintage';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT st.setCode) AS translated_set_count
FROM sets AS s
JOIN set_translations AS st ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.block = 'Commander'
  AND st.language = 'Portuguese (Brasil)';
